hub.title: VASP Cheat Sheets: INCAR, KPOINTS, POTCAR, Slurm
hub.description: VASP cheat sheets for VASP 6: INCAR tags and recipes, KPOINTS, POTCAR, Slurm scripts, output commands, errors, relaxation, magnetism, NEB and AIMD.
hub.lede: What to type, how to check that it worked, and what usually goes wrong, for the everyday jobs of a VASP calculation. Each sheet is organized by task, gives the default and the recommended value side by side, and says why, with a link to the lecture that explains the physics.
hub.imageAlt: The INCAR builder from the VASP cheat sheets: choices for a ferromagnetic metal cell relaxation on the left, and the commented INCAR it writes on the right.
